text:
anya: AM check — quick dump: landed prefetch patch (PR #4823) last night. Observed ~1-2% throughput drop on microbench for long sequences. Disabled slot-coalescing for the canary to isolate. I'll run a nightly kv-warmup sweep at 02:30 UTC; flag me if you see collisions. Quick asks: any regressions from your side? ok to re-enable coalescing for seq <= 512 on canary with a flag?

samir: saw a small blip on canary around 03:10 UTC, p95 +18ms for 2048-seq on a3 nodes. Suspect the kernel_v2 scheduling change. I'll run a kernel bisect today. @anya pls add me to the rollout list.

jonah: CI logs show an OOM in shard 7 after prefetch enabled — snippet:
```log
[2026-03-17 03:12:45] OOM reached: shard 7, alloc 9.8GB
```
Triaging now, could be kv eviction threshold interacting with long-lived refs.

kevin: quick bench run (local): `./bench/run.sh --model gpt-neox-20b --seq 1,512,2048 --slots 8` => throughput measured: seq=1: 480 tps, seq=512: 120 tps, seq=2048: 24 tps. p95 for 2048 increased after PR. Will upload raw csv.

ciara: no objections to re-enable coalescing for seq <= 512 behind a canary flag + telemetry. Stronger ask: add a regression alert on p95 > baseline +10% specifically for the long-seq bucket.

bench-bot: nightly kv-warmup scheduled at 2026-03-18T02:30:00Z. Will post completion status in this thread.

anya: plan: Samir bisects kernel_v2 today; Jonah triages OOM and tests lowering kv_keep_alive; Kevin uploads bench CSV and links artifact; Ciara will draft telemetry + alert rule; I will open follow-up PR to add canary flag + rollback policy. If anyone needs immediate help ping @anya :thumbsup:

samir: ack — starting bisect now, ETA ~3h.

jonah: memory profile looks like prefetch keeps stale KV refs. Quick workaround to test: reduce `kv_keep_alive` from 30s -> 10s in config and re-run smoke. Testing now.

kevin: uploaded bench CSV: s3://redwood-inference/eng-runtime/bench/1707772123-prepatch.csv and pushed stripped graphs to #eng-runtime-artifacts.

ciara: adding alert and a tiny dashboard tile for seq buckets (1 / 512 / 2048). Will link the dashboard here once live.

anya: thanks team. If we don't hit blockers by EOD we'll re-enable coalescing for small seqs on canary. Otherwise hold and triage. End of morning mini-dump.
